Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer at step 8 incorrectly identifies Julia Crawford Ivers as the director of "The Majesty Of The Law" (1915) and extracts her birth year as 1869. This is a critical data fabrication error because the film "The Majesty Of The Law" in the context of comparing directors born later is likely a different, more recent film, or the search results were misinterpreted to conflate the director of a 1915 silent film with the intended subject. This error leads to the final conclusion that Ivers (born 1869) was born later than T. V. Chandran (born 1950), which is factually wrong given the actual birth years of the relevant directors for the intended comparison.
